new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Data Governance & Analytics
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

The Senior Program Manager, Data Governance & Analytics establishes and leads the data governance, reporting, and analytics strategy for Global Program Controls. This role is accountable for ensuring that portfolio delivery data is consistently defined, accurately maintained, appropriately governed, and translated into actionable insights for senior leadership.

As the recognized subject matter expert for program data and performance reporting, this individual will define the policies, standards, operating mechanisms, and analytical capabilities that enable trusted decision-making across the global portfolio. The role owns the authoritative delivery data framework, executive portfolio dashboards, operational reporting suite, data quality program, stewardship network, and reporting calendar.

This position operates across multiple organizations and systems, including Jira, Primavera Cloud, Apex, Unifier, financial platforms, and business intelligence tools. The Senior Program Manager will influence senior leaders, program controls teams, technology partners, finance organizations, and functional stakeholders to establish consistent data practices and improve portfolio visibility.

The successful candidate combines deep expertise in data governance, business intelligence, and program controls with strong executive communication and cross-functional leadership. This is a highly influential individual contributor role that leads enterprise-scale programs and processes through expertise, partnership, and strategic influence rather than direct people management.

Key Responsibilities

Data Governance Strategy and Leadership

Establish and lead the Global Program Controls Data Governance program, including its strategy, policies, standards, operating model, controls, and performance measures.
Develop the overarching data governance policy framework and ensure alignment with enterprise data, security, compliance, and technology requirements.
Define decision rights, ownership models, escalation paths, and governance forums for portfolio delivery data.
Advise leadership on data governance, reporting strategy, analytical capability, and portfolio performance measurement.
Evaluate emerging technologies, governance practices, and analytical approaches that can improve data quality, accessibility, automation, and decision-making.
Lead complex, cross-functional data initiatives that span multiple organizations, regions, business processes, and technology platforms.

Data Standards, Dictionary, and Lineage

Lead development and maintenance of the authoritative data dictionary for delivery data across Jira, Primavera Cloud, Unifier, financial systems, and reporting platforms.
Define standard business terms, metric definitions, calculation methodologies, source-system ownership, and acceptable-use requirements.
Establish and maintain data lineage documentation that maps data from source systems through integrations, transformations, semantic models, dashboards, and reports.
Ensure that key portfolio metrics have documented definitions, accountable owners, approved sources, and transparent calculation logic.
Resolve conflicting definitions and promote consistent use of data and metrics across teams and regions.

Data Quality and Issue Resolution

Define and enforce data quality rules for completeness, validity, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness.
Establish scheduled data quality monitoring, automated validation checks, exception reporting, and data quality scorecards.
Create measurable data quality targets and communicate trends, gaps, and risks to leadership and data owners.
Operate the data issue resolution process, giving stakeholders a clear mechanism to report suspected data defects.
Lead root-cause analysis and corrective-action efforts for recurring or high-impact data issues.
Partner with system owners and business teams to address upstream process weaknesses rather than relying solely on downstream corrections.
Ensure executive and operational reports are validated for accuracy and completeness before distribution.

Master Data and Data Stewardship

Govern critical master and reference data, including canonical site names, project identifiers, regional hierarchies, organizational structures, program classifications, and reporting dimensions.
Establish and manage a cross-functional data stewardship network.
Identify data owners and stewards within each functional area and define their responsibilities, decision authority, and expected service levels.
Provide training, guidance, tools, and ongoing support to data stewards and contributors.
Facilitate governance forums that address data quality, definition changes, ownership gaps, and cross-system alignment.
Mentor peers and stakeholders on governance, reporting, data interpretation, and analytical best practices.

Executive Reporting and Analytics

Own the strategy, design, development, and ongoing maintenance of the global portfolio executive dashboard and operational reporting suite.
Translate complex program, schedule, cost, risk, and workflow data into clear, visually compelling insights for vice presidents and other senior leaders.
Establish reporting standards covering templates, visualization conventions, metric definitions, validation protocols, version control, distribution, and retention.
Manage the reporting calendar and ensure reports are produced, reviewed, approved, and distributed according to established cadences.
Respond to ad hoc leadership requests for custom analysis, scenario evaluation, and portfolio deep dives.

Systems and Data Partnerships

Partner with systems integration, data engineering, IT, and application teams to ensure reliable and scalable data flows.
Define business requirements for integrations, data models, reporting layers, controls, and workflow enhancements.
Partner with system owners to align data access policies with role-based access, confidentiality, security, and business requirements.
Assess the downstream reporting and governance impact of system, process, and data-model changes.
Ensure analytical products draw from governed, traceable, and trusted data sources.
Drive adoption of reusable data products and self-service reporting capabilities while maintaining appropriate governance and controls.

Stakeholder Leadership and Influence

Build and maintain a broad network across Global Program Controls, delivery organizations, finance, IT, data engineering, system administration, and senior leadership.
Lead through influence across teams where formal authority may not exist.
Communicate recommendations, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Facilitate alignment among stakeholders with competing requirements, definitions, or priorities.
Represent Global Program Controls in enterprise data, reporting, and technology forums.
Provide coaching and mentorship to analysts, program managers, data stewards, and other peers across the line of business.
Foster inclusive collaboration by ensuring relevant stakeholders are represented in governance, reporting, and decision-making activities.

Responsibilities

Required Qualifications

Extensive experience leading data governance, analytics, business intelligence, program controls, or enterprise reporting in a complex global environment.
Demonstrated experience building or significantly maturing a data governance or enterprise reporting program.
Expert knowledge of at least one relevant specialist area, such as data governance, business intelligence, program controls, data management, or portfolio analytics.
Deep understanding of:
Data quality management
Master and reference data management
Data lineage and metadata management
Data ownership and stewardship
Metric governance
Reporting controls
Analytical data modeling

Expert proficiency with Power BI or Tableau, including dashboard design, semantic or data modeling, calculated measures, and report distribution.
Strong knowledge of program controls and performance metrics, including schedule variance, cost variance, forecast accuracy, service-level performance, and earned value.
Experience extracting, interpreting, reconciling, or reporting data from Primavera P6 and Jira.
Experience defining executive dashboards and translating complex data into concise, decision-oriented narratives.
Demonstrated success influencing senior leaders and cross-functional teams across organizational boundaries.
Ability to lead multiple complex initiatives with significant business impact, ambiguity, and interdependencies.
Strong written, verbal, facilitation, and executive presentation skills.
Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and enterprise reporting or analytics platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting construction, capital programs, infrastructure delivery, or data center development.
Familiarity with DAMA-DMBOK or comparable data governance frameworks.
Experience with Unifier, or similar capital project management systems.
Knowledge of financial reporting, including budget-versus-actual analysis, cash-flow forecasting, and cost forecasting.
Experience partnering with data engineering teams on integrations, transformation logic, data warehouses, or semantic reporting layers.
Experience implementing automated data quality monitoring or governance workflow tools.
Familiarity with predictive analytics, artificial intelligence, or machine-learning applications for program controls and portfolio management.
Experience operating in a large, globally distributed enterprise environment.

Key Partners

Global Program Controls leadership
Systems Integration and Data Engineering
Program and Project Controls teams
Reporting and Analytics teams
Root Cause Analysis leaders
Functional and regional pillar leads
Data owners and data stewards
Information Technology and enterprise data teams
Finance and business operations
Scheduling, cost management, risk, and delivery organizations

Scope and Impact

Serves as the recognized subject matter expert for data governance, analytics, and portfolio reporting within the line of business.
Leads strategies, programs, and operating processes that have a material impact on portfolio visibility, data trust, and leadership decision-making.
Advises senior leadership on decisions involving data strategy, performance measurement, governance, systems, and reporting.
Leads work that spans multiple functions, systems, organizations, and geographic regions.
Addresses complex and ambiguous problems by examining systemic causes, applying industry best practices, and introducing innovative or non-conventional approaches.
Regularly contributes to strategic planning and decision-making for Global Program Controls.
Establishes scalable capabilities that improve how the organization manages data, measures performance, identifies risk, and executes its global portfolio.

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst (HQ)
new_jobs.description:
Koniag Services Inc., a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a talented and experienced Data Analyst to support headquarters-level data analysis, performance reporting, and strategic decision support for our IT Call Center program operations in the Washington, DC area. The ideal candidate is a highly analytical and detail-oriented professional with a strong command of data analytics, reporting tools, and visualization platforms, and a demonstrated ability to synthesize complex, multi-site operational data into clear and compelling insights for senior leadership and government stakeholders. They bring a strategic perspective, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-visibility headquarters environment. Ability to obtain a government security clearance may be required to support Koniag Services Inc. and our government customers. This position is located in the Washington, DC area.

We offer competitive compensation and an extraordinary benefits package including health, dental and vision insurance, 401K with company matching, flexible spending accounts, paid holidays, three weeks paid time off, and more.

Position Description

The Headquarters Data Analyst will serve as a central analytical resource supporting the enterprise-wide performance monitoring, reporting, and data governance functions of the IT Call Center program. This individual will work closely with the Senior Program Manager, program leadership, and site-level operations teams to aggregate, analyze, and present program-wide performance data, support strategic planning activities, and ensure that all headquarters-level reporting requirements are met with accuracy and consistency. Principal responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

Serve as the primary data analyst supporting headquarters-level program performance monitoring, aggregating and analyzing operational data from multiple call center sites to provide a comprehensive, enterprise-wide view of program performance.
Design, develop, and maintain advanced performance dashboards, scorecards, and analytical reports that provide senior program leadership and government stakeholders with timely, accurate, and actionable visibility into program-wide call center performance metrics.
Collect, validate, and consolidate operational data submissions from site-level operations teams, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and completeness of all data inputs prior to incorporation into headquarters-level reports and briefings.
Conduct in-depth analysis of program-wide operational data including call volumes, ticket trends, SLA compliance, first call resolution rates, escalation patterns, workforce utilization, and customer satisfaction scores, identifying cross-site trends, performance gaps, and strategic improvement opportunities.
Lead the preparation and quality assurance review of all headquarters-level customer-facing deliverables including monthly and quarterly performance reports, program scorecards, and executive briefing materials for senior government leadership.
Support the Senior Program Manager and headquarters leadership team in the development of data-driven strategic recommendations, program improvement initiatives, and resource allocation strategies informed by enterprise performance data.
Develop and maintain a program-wide operational metrics baseline and performance benchmarking framework, conducting regular comparisons across sites and against industry standards to identify best practices and areas requiring targeted improvement.
Collaborate with site-level operations analysts and program staff to ensure alignment of data definitions, reporting methodologies, and performance measurement standards across all program locations.
Support data governance activities including the development and enforcement of data quality standards, reporting templates, data dictionary maintenance, and analytical process documentation.
Assist in the management and continuous improvement of the program's data infrastructure, including ITSM platform reporting configurations, data extraction processes, and dashboard maintenance.
Prepare and present analytical findings, program performance summaries, and strategic recommendations to senior program leadership and government stakeholders in both written and verbal formats.
Respond to ad hoc data requests and analytical tasks from headquarters leadership and government stakeholders, delivering accurate, insightful, and well-presented outputs within established timelines.
Support continuous improvement initiatives at the headquarters level by identifying cross-site operational inefficiencies, analyzing root causes, and developing data-supported improvement recommendations.
Contribute to business development activities as needed, including supporting proposal efforts with program performance data, analytical capability narratives, and past performance documentation.

Required

Education and Experience:

Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business Administration, Information Technology, Statistics, Operations Management, or a related field from an accredited college or university.
4+ years of experience in a data analysis, business intelligence, or operations analysis role, with demonstrated experience supporting enterprise-level or multi-site reporting functions.
Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining performance dashboards, analytical reports, and data visualization products for senior leadership and executive audiences.
Experience working within a federal government contracting environment.
Experience working with large, complex datasets from multiple sources to produce consolidated, enterprise-level analytical outputs.

Preferred

Master's degree in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Information Technology, Statistics, or a related field.
Prior experience supporting headquarters or enterprise-level data analysis functions for a federal IT call center, service desk, or IT managed services program.
Experience working in a high-visibility, senior leadership-facing analytical role within a government contracting environment.

Required Skills And Competencies

Exceptional communication skills in English – both written and oral – with the ability to present complex data findings, analytical insights, and strategic recommendations clearly and persuasively to executive-level government stakeholders and senior program leadership.
Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to aggregate, validate, and interpret large volumes of multi-source operational data to identify enterprise-wide trends, performance patterns, and strategic improvement opportunities.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas, pivot tables, data modeling, dynamic charting, and macro development for sophisticated operational reporting and analysis.
Advanced proficiency in data visualization platforms such as Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent tools, with demonstrated experience designing executive-level dashboards and interactive, multi-site analytical reports.
Proficiency in data querying languages such as SQL for extracting, transforming, and analyzing data from relational databases and ITSM platforms.
Hands-on experience with IT Service Management (ITSM) platforms such as ServiceNow, Remedy, or equivalent systems, including experience extracting and analyzing platform data for enterprise reporting purposes.
Working knowledge of IT service management principles and ITIL frameworks, including SLA governance, incident management, and continuous service improvement.
Strong data governance skills with experience developing and enforcing data quality standards, reporting templates, and analytical process documentation.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Outlook) and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams and SharePoint for documentation, communication, and reporting purposes.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-priority deliverables simultaneously, maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines in a fast-paced headquarters environment.
Ability to obtain and maintain a government security clearance as required.

Desired Skills And Competencies

Active government security clearance (Secret or higher).
ITIL Foundation certification or higher (ITIL Intermediate or ITIL 4 Managing Professional).
Experience with advanced analytics or statistical programming languages such as Python or R for large-scale data analysis and modeling.
Lean Six Sigma White Belt, Yellow Belt, or Green Belt certification.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or demonstrated project management experience supporting analytical programs.
Experience with enterprise data warehouse platforms, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, or equivalent data integration tools.
Familiarity with federal IT governance frameworks and reporting requirements such as FITARA, FedRAMP, or NIST cybersecurity standards.
Experience supporting quality assurance (QA) programs and integrating customer satisfaction data into enterprise performance reporting frameworks.
Familiarity with workforce management platforms and call center performance analytics tools used in a multi-site operational environment.
Experience contributing to business development efforts including proposal writing, analytical capability development, and past performance documentation.
Knowledge of Earned Value Management (EVM) principles and reporting within a federal contract environment.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

The company is an equal opportunity employer. The company shall not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, color, religion, creed, ethnicity, sex, sexual orientation, gender or gender identity (except where gender is a bona fide occupational qualification), national origin or ancestry, age, disability, citizenship, military/veteran status, marital status, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We are committed to equal employment opportunity in all decisions related to employment, promotion, wages, benefits, and all other privileges, terms, and conditions of employment.

The company is dedicated to seeking all qualified applicants. If you require an accommodation to navigate or to apply to a position on our website, please contact Heaven Wood via e-mail at accommodations@koniag-gs.com or by calling 703-488-9377 to request accommodations.

Koniag Government Services (KGS) is an Alaska Native Owned corporation supporting the values and traditions of our native communities through an agile employee and corporate culture that delivers Enterprise Solutions, Professional Services and Operational Management to Federal Government Agencies. new_jobs.title: Research Data Analyst (School of Medicine Pediatric Infectious Diseases)
new_jobs.description:
About Our Client
The organization operates in the field of pediatric infectious disease research, focusing on improving treatment outcomes for children with tuberculosis (TB). It addresses challenges in pediatric TB care by conducting clinical trials and research studies designed to identify shorter, safer, and more effective treatment regimens. Its research programs involve collaboration across international clinical sites, expanding the reach and impact of its work.
About the Opportunity
The Research Data Analyst
supports data analysis and clinical research activities for studies including the SMART4TB TA2 Therapeutics study and the SMILE-TB trial. This role contributes to data collection, statistical analysis, reporting, and database management while applying clinical expertise to interpret pediatric TB research findings. The position also supports data quality, participant safety, and collaboration across multidisciplinary research teams.
Responsibilities
• Collect research data and generate reports, analytical models, and study findings.
• Run statistical models and prepare analytical reports for assigned research studies.
• Conduct data analyses supporting clinical research objectives and study outcomes.
• Use statistical software packages to analyze and interpret research data.
• Design tables and other formats to clearly present analytical results.
• Manage or assist with data entry and maintenance of research databases.
• Review, edit, and finalize study-related documents in collaboration with research teams.
• Review and summarize safety data, including adverse event reports.
• Provide clinical guidance regarding the management and interpretation of pediatric TB adverse events.
• Participate as a clinical expert in the Clinical Management Committee.
• Support data analysis teams by providing clinical interpretation of research findings.
• Generate, review, and resolve data queries within REDCap.
• Perform quality assurance activities to protect research participant rights, safety, and data integrity.
• Collaborate with investigators, data management teams, and clinical research personnel as needed.
• Perform additional research and analytical duties as assigned.
Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline.
• Minimum of three years of related professional experience; additional education may substitute in accordance with applicable equivalency guidelines.
• Three years of direct patient care experience in resource-limited hospital settings.
• Proficiency with STATA and/or R, REDCap, EndNote, Microsoft Word, and Microsoft Excel.
• Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.
• Ability to apply clinical knowledge to research data analysis and safety assessments.
• Preferred experience diagnosing and treating pediatric TB in low-resource settings.
• Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish preferred.
Pay Range and Compensation Package
• Starting hourly salary range of $25.23–$44.20

new_jobs.title: Water Quality & Environmental Compliance Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Missouri American Water
is seeking a compliance-minded, results-driven individual to join our team in Neosho, MO
! As the Water Quality & Environmental Program Manager
, you will get to work with both water and wastewater including sampling, troubleshooting, customer interaction, and maintaining documentation and regulatory reporting. Our ideal candidate will have experience sampling and have existing knowledge of water and/or wastewater regulations and compliance standards.

Responsible for organizing advanced functions and activities related to environmental management and water quality for assigned facilities. Responsible for maintaining all applicable lab certifications, accreditations, or approvals to conduct compliance and process quality control work. Implements the day to day collection of water quality samples. Implements programs to ensure compliance with all water quality and environmental regulations. Assists in resolving treatment issues. Investigates water quality complaints and determines course of action needed.

Please note that this role is located at our operations in Neosho, MO.

Key Accountabilities

Manage monitoring and reporting programs to ensure compliance with federal and state water quality and environmental regulations and company standards for assigned facilities.
Conduct advanced sampling and/or analysis and special projects. (50%)
Obtain, prepare, file and maintain all regulatory reports and records.
Manage required permits and make any necessary modifications and renewals.
Participate in internal and external audits and represent American Water with regulators and customers.
Identify potential issues and problems and initiate responsive actions and mitigate environmental violations (10%)
Supervise, monitor, and calibrate analyzers/equipment, etc. to ensure established standards of performance and accuracy are maintained (10%)
Conduct advanced projects and prepare reports as needed (5%)
Investigate and respond to escalated water quality complaints or concerns.
Responsible for planning, preparing and controlling the portion of the financial plan relating to responsibilities (5%)

Knowledge/Skills

Knowledge of federal and state environmental standards and regulations and understanding of current environmental legislation and regulations
Regulatory knowledge of proper lab analytical testing methods
Must understand principles of water and/or wastewater treatment and be able to troubleshoot systems

Experience/Education

Bachelor's degree preferred
Will consider equivalent work experience in related field/industry
Minimum Five (5) years experience in water, wastewater, and laboratory operations

Travel Requirements

Local and regional travel
Rare overnight travel may be required
Valid state driver's license required

Work Environment

Laboratory, Indoor/Outdoor, production/office environments

Work Schedule

Full-time, On-site
Monday-Friday, day shift
On call responsibility
